program.name: Slow and Steady
program.subject: Endurance & control
program.blurb: Strength at a crawl, then a breathing flow: the patience to fuck her slowly and not speed up.
program.about: Three slow days, which is what a long, unhurried fuck takes. Lower body at a three-second tempo, upper body the same, and a breath-led flow day with pelvic-floor holds. Nothing is fast and nothing is rushed: the goal is to feel every rep and stay relaxed while you work, which is what control in bed actually is when you are inside her. Level II slows the tempo, Level III adds reps.
program.split: Slow lower / slow upper / breath flow
